name: CACH4 independent-negative metadata eligibility filter
research_question: Do the coordinate-resolved JPL CACH4 train backgrounds retain at least 20 independent non-protected 25 km components after excluding official-test geography and every previously counted MARS-Hyperspectral negative pair?

prior_stage_b_pairs.line_ending_note: The tracked receipt hashes canonical LF JSONL; the ignored Windows file has CRLF bytes. Both identities are frozen.

distance_contract.boundary: distance <= 25.0 km is excluded or connected; only distance > 25.0 km is independent

filters.official_test_protection: Build one representative coordinate per MARS location_name from permitted columns; protected locations are those with split_name beginning with test; exclude a JPL crop within or on 25 km of any protected representative coordinate.
filters.prior_negative_pair_deduplication: Select only NO_PLUME sample IDs from the already counted Stage B pair catalog, join their authoritative source coordinates from the train mask catalog, and exclude a JPL crop within or on 25 km of any joined prior-negative coordinate.
filters.eligibility: coordinate_resolved AND not official_test_protected AND not prior_negative_pair_duplicate
filters.all_mars_novelty: novel_beyond_all_mars_25km is true only when the crop is more than 25 km from every MARS representative location; it is descriptive and not an extra eligibility filter.

grouping.method: connected components of eligible JPL crop centers with edges at haversine distance <= 25.0 km
grouping.identity: stable hash of sorted member sample IDs
grouping.reason: Using components rather than tiles or flightline IDs is the conservative interpretation of the frozen nonprotected-candidate-location gate.

gates.metadata_stage_pass: all four parent metadata gates pass, including license, at least 100 resolved train backgrounds, exact UTC/center availability, and at least 20 eligible connected 25 km components
